programme.title: British Touring Car Championship Highlights

programme.title: The Lineup
programme.desc: 1958. Crime. Directed by Don Siegel. Stars Eli Wallach, Robert Keith & Richard Jaeckel. A ruthless hitman is sent to recover packages of drugs hidden inside the luggage of unsuspecting travellers.

programme.title: Budgie
programme.desc: Run Rabbit Run Rabbit. Stars: Adam Faith, Iain Cuthbertson & Lynn Dalby. Endell is after Budgie and this time he means business and wants blood. It seems that Budgie's friends are getting fewer.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: The Food of the Gods
programme.desc: 1976. Horror. Directed by Bert I. Gordon. Stars Marjoe Gortner, Pamela Franklin & Ralph Meeker. A remote island is taken over by gigantic beasts after the appearance of a strange, edible ooze.

programme.title: Harold Shipman: Dr. Death
programme.desc: 2001. Drama. Directed by Roger Bamford. Stars Michael Stainton & Olive Pendleton. Compelling drama based on the real life story of the respected doctor who became Britain's biggest serial killer.

programme.title: Tell Me Another
programme.desc: Stories About Their Early Lives 4. 1976. Personal anecdotes as told to Dick Hills. This episode stars Acker Bilk, Tom O'Connor, Sydney Tafler & Norman Wisdom.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: The Hunters. Directed by Aaron Spelling and starring Don Durant and Mark Goddard. Ringo and Cully join a pair of guards from Yuma prison searching for three escaped convicts.

programme.title: Murder in Eden
programme.desc: 1961. Thriller. Director: Max Varnel. Stars: Ray McAnally, Catherine Feller, Yvonne Buckingham. After discovering a famous painting is a forgery, a noted art critic is killed by driver.

programme.title: Account Rendered
programme.desc: 1957. Thriller. Directed by Peter Graham Scott. Stars Honor Blackman, Griffith Jones & Ursula Howells. When a wealthy banker's wife is found murdered, the police find many suspects with a motive.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Put your dancing shoes on and take a step back in time for Eden Kane's Someone Wants to Know.

programme.title: Laxdale Hall
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy. Car owners of a remote Scottish village refuse to pay road funds until a proper road has been built. Starring Ronald Squire, Fulton Mackay & Prunella Scales.

programme.title: Linda
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Directed by Don Sharp. Stars Carol White, Alan Rothwell & Lois Daine. A bored teenager finds excitement in the life of crime, but his interests change when he starts to fall in love.

programme.title: The Tall Men
programme.desc: 1955. Western. Directed by Raoul Walsh. Stars Clark Gable, Jane Russell & Robert Ryan. Two brothers and their pompous employer make an arduous journey across the frontier driving a herd of cattle.

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: 1955. Crime. Director: Ken Hughes. Stars Sydney Chaplin, Audrey Dalton & Jefferson Clifford. After several killings of thieves occur, a priest is then marked for murder after hearing a confession.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Bank Raising. 1964. Stars Buddy Ebsen, Raymond Bailey & Lester Matthews. Invited to the groundbreaking for a new bank, the Clampetts confuse the event with an old-fashioned barn raising.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1957. Night Crossing. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Starring Russell Napier, John Serret and Andre Maranne. The quiet of an idyllic port town is shattered when a body is found on the beach.

programme.title: Bonanza

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of... Indie Sleaze
